channel.title: The Haka Party Incident
channel.desc: PREMIERE: In 1979, group of young M?ori and Pasifika activists sought to stop P?keh? students at the University of Auckland performing a parody of haka each capping week. Unfortunately, the consequences for those activists were severe ? many were convicted of crimes. Director Katie Wolfe uncovers this largely forgotten event in our history with interviews from both in this resonant and thought-provoking documentary.
